EC1: Major depressive disorder with psychotic features
EC2: Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) [AND] with a clear impact on activities of daily living
EC3: Developmental delay [OR], intellectual deficit [OR], and/or severe educational disability [AND] resulting in some dependence for activities of daily living
EC4: Ongoing substance use disorder [AND] with significant impact on activities of daily living. Difficult or impossible to determine whether cognitive or functional decline is due to substance use or HIV [OR], or both
EC5: Evidence of intoxication [OR] or withdrawal during the screening evaluation
EC6: Central nervous system (CNS) infections [OR]  or opportunistic conditions: brain abscess (bacterial [OR], mycobacterial [OR], fungal [OR] or Toxoplasma) [OR], meningitis [OR] with persistent neurologic impairment, primary CNS lymphoma [OR], progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML) [OR], or another structural brain lesion [AND] with neurological sequelae
EC7: Other CNS conditions: non-opportunistic primary [OR] or metastatic brain tumors [OR], uncontrolled seizure disorder [OR], progressive multiple sclerosis [OR], stroke [OR] with neurological sequelae, or dementia due to causes [NOT] other than HIV (eg, Alzheimer's disease)
EC8: Constitutional illness (eg, persistent unexplained fever [OR], diarrhea [OR], significant weight loss [OR], disabling weakness) within 30 days of screening
EC9: Known untreated B12 deficiency [OR] or malnutrition (body mass index [BMI] less than 18) at screening
EC10: Evidence of current hepatitis C virus infection (HCV) (ie, HCV antibody [Ab] positive within 90 days prior to study entry unless also shown to be plasma HCV RNA negative within the same time period)
EC11: Unstable and advanced liver disease (as defined by the presence of at least one of the following: ascites [OR], encephalopathy [OR], coagulopathy [OR], hypoalbuminemia [OR], esophageal [OR] or gastric varices [OR], or persistent jaundice)
EC12: Prior [OR] or current use of any CCR5 antagonist [OR] (such as MVC [OR] and cenicriviroc [CVC]) and integrase inhibitor (such as RAL [OR], DTG [OR], and elvitegravir [EVG])
EC13: Current use of any medication, including antiretrovirals, prohibited in the study (refer to the A5324 protocol-specific web page [PSWP] for the prohibited medications)
EC15: Presence of an AIDS-defining opportunistic infection within 6 months prior to entry. Note: Refer to the A5324 Manual of Operations (MOPS) for the list of AIDS-defining opportunistic infections.
EC16: Active syphilis [OR] or treatment [AND] for syphilis within 90 days prior to study entry. NOTE: Active syphilis is defined as four-fold increase in serum rapid plasma reagin (RPR) [OR] or venereal disease research laboratory (VDRL) tests in an individual with past syphilis [OR], or newly reactive serum RPR [OR] or VDRL with a reactive confirmatory test (enzyme immunoassays [EIA] [OR] or chemiluminescent assay [CIA] [OR], T. pallidum particle agglutination [TP-PA] [OR], or fluorescent treponemal antibody absorbed [FTA-ABS]).
EC17: Known allergy [OR]/sensitivity [OR] or any hypersensitivity [AND] to components of study drugs or their formulation
